audit_events_actor_ck.name: audit_events_actor_ck
audit_events_actor_ck.value: ("audit_events"."actor_type" = 'user' and "audit_events"."actor_identity_id" is not null) or ("audit_events"."actor_type" <> 'user' and "audit_events"."actor_reference" is not null and length(btrim("audit_events"."actor_reference")) > 0)

identity_admin_intents_target_ck.name: identity_admin_intents_target_ck
identity_admin_intents_target_ck.value: ("identity_admin_intents"."operation" = 'invitation_delivery' and "identity_admin_intents"."invitation_id" is not null and "identity_admin_intents"."recovery_request_id" is null) or ("identity_admin_intents"."operation" = 'identity_relink' and "identity_admin_intents"."target_identity_id" is not null and "identity_admin_intents"."invitation_id" is null and "identity_admin_intents"."recovery_request_id" is null) or ("identity_admin_intents"."operation" = 'mfa_enrollment_reset' and "identity_admin_intents"."target_identity_id" is not null and "identity_admin_intents"."recovery_request_id" is not null and "identity_admin_intents"."invitation_id" is null)

identity_admin_intents_lease_context_ck.name: identity_admin_intents_lease_context_ck
identity_admin_intents_lease_context_ck.value: ("identity_admin_intents"."lease_token" is null and "identity_admin_intents"."work_mode" is null) or ("identity_admin_intents"."lease_token" is not null and "identity_admin_intents"."work_mode" is not null and "identity_admin_intents"."correlation_id" is not null and "identity_admin_intents"."initiated_by_identity_id" is not null and "identity_admin_intents"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

identity_admin_intents_lifecycle_ck.name: identity_admin_intents_lifecycle_ck
identity_admin_intents_lifecycle_ck.value: ("identity_admin_intents"."state" = 'pending' and "identity_admin_intents"."claimed_at" is null and "identity_admin_intents"."lease_expires_at" is null and "identity_admin_intents"."completed_at" is null) or ("identity_admin_intents"."state" = 'in_flight' and "identity_admin_intents"."claimed_at" is not null and "identity_admin_intents"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "identity_admin_intents"."completed_at" is null) or ("identity_admin_intents"."state" in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'outcome_unknown') and "identity_admin_intents"."claimed_at" is not null and "identity_admin_intents"."completed_at" is not null) or ("identity_admin_intents"."state" = 'cancelled' and "identity_admin_intents"."completed_at" is not null)

identity_recovery_approvals_approved_ck.name: identity_recovery_approvals_approved_ck
identity_recovery_approvals_approved_ck.value: "identity_recovery_approvals"."decision" <> 'approved' or ("identity_recovery_approvals"."assurance" = 'aal2' and "identity_recovery_approvals"."pre_existing_contact_attested" and "identity_recovery_approvals"."phone_check_result" = 'confirmed' and "identity_recovery_approvals"."evidence_reference" is not null and length(btrim("identity_recovery_approvals"."evidence_reference")) > 0)

identity_recovery_presence_lifecycle_ck.name: identity_recovery_presence_lifecycle_ck
identity_recovery_presence_lifecycle_ck.value: ("identity_recovery_presence"."state" = 'pending' and "identity_recovery_presence"."linked_request_id" is null and "identity_recovery_presence"."linked_at" is null and "identity_recovery_presence"."completed_at" is null and "identity_recovery_presence"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("identity_recovery_presence"."state" = 'linked' and "identity_recovery_presence"."linked_request_id" is not null and "identity_recovery_presence"."linked_at" is not null and "identity_recovery_presence"."completed_at" is null and "identity_recovery_presence"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("identity_recovery_presence"."state" = 'completed' and "identity_recovery_presence"."linked_request_id" is not null and "identity_recovery_presence"."completed_at" is not null and "identity_recovery_presence"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("identity_recovery_presence"."state" = 'cancelled' and "identity_recovery_presence"."cancelled_at" is not null and "identity_recovery_presence"."completed_at" is null) or ("identity_recovery_presence"."state" = 'expired' and "identity_recovery_presence"."completed_at" is null)

identity_recovery_requests_lifecycle_ck.name: identity_recovery_requests_lifecycle_ck
identity_recovery_requests_lifecycle_ck.value: ("identity_recovery_requests"."state" = 'pending' and "identity_recovery_requests"."approved_at" is null and "identity_recovery_requests"."completed_at" is null and "identity_recovery_requests"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("identity_recovery_requests"."state" = 'approved' and "identity_recovery_requests"."approved_at" is not null and "identity_recovery_requests"."completed_at" is null and "identity_recovery_requests"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("identity_recovery_requests"."state" = 'completed' and "identity_recovery_requests"."approved_at" is not null and "identity_recovery_requests"."completed_at" is not null and "identity_recovery_requests"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("identity_recovery_requests"."state" in ('expired', 'cancelled') and "identity_recovery_requests"."completed_at" is null)

security_bootstrap_state_consumed_ck.name: security_bootstrap_state_consumed_ck
security_bootstrap_state_consumed_ck.value: ("security_bootstrap_state"."state" = 'prepared' and "security_bootstrap_state"."consumed_at" is null) or ("security_bootstrap_state"."state" = 'consumed' and "security_bootstrap_state"."consumed_at" is not null)

identity_intent_attempts_lifecycle_ck.name: identity_intent_attempts_lifecycle_ck
identity_intent_attempts_lifecycle_ck.value:
("identity_intent_attempts"."completed_at" is null and "identity_intent_attempts"."outcome" is null and "identity_intent_attempts"."safe_error_code" is null
        and "identity_intent_attempts"."result_code" is null and "identity_intent_attempts"."next_action" is null)
      or ("identity_intent_attempts"."completed_at" is not null and "identity_intent_attempts"."completed_at" >= "identity_intent_attempts"."started_at"
        and "identity_intent_attempts"."outcome" is not null and "identity_intent_attempts"."next_action" is not null
        and "identity_intent_attempts"."outcome" in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'outcome_unknown')
        and "identity_intent_attempts"."next_action" in ('none', 'retry', 'reconcile', 'manual_review'))

identities_verified_email_uq.name: identities_verified_email_uq
identities_verified_email_uq.where: "identities"."normalized_email" is not null and "identities"."email_verified_at" is not null and "identities"."status" <> 'archived'

identities_lifecycle_ck.name: identities_lifecycle_ck
identities_lifecycle_ck.value: ("identities"."status" = 'pending' and "identities"."activated_at" is null and "identities"."suspended_at" is null and "identities"."archived_at" is null) or ("identities"."status" in ('active', 'recovery_pending') and "identities"."activated_at" is not null and "identities"."suspended_at" is null and "identities"."archived_at" is null) or ("identities"."status" = 'suspended' and "identities"."activated_at" is not null and "identities"."suspended_at" is not null and "identities"."archived_at" is null) or ("identities"."status" = 'archived' and "identities"."archived_at" is not null)

invitations_terminal_fields_ck.name: invitations_terminal_fields_ck
invitations_terminal_fields_ck.value: ("invitations"."status" = 'accepted' and "invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and ("invitations"."accepted_by_identity_id" is not null or "invitations"."migration_review_required") and "invitations"."revoked_at" is null) or ("invitations"."status" = 'revoked' and "invitations"."revoked_at" is not null and "invitations"."revoked_reason" is not null and "invitations"."accepted_at" is null) or ("invitations"."status" in ('pending', 'expired') and "invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "invitations"."accepted_by_identity_id" is null and "invitations"."revoked_at" is null and "invitations"."revoked_by_identity_id" is null and "invitations"."revoked_reason" is null)

org_members_revocation_ck.name: org_members_revocation_ck

org_members_lifecycle_ck.name: org_members_lifecycle_ck
org_members_lifecycle_ck.value: ("org_members"."status" = 'active' and "org_members"."suspended_at" is null) or ("org_members"."status" = 'suspended' and "org_members"."suspended_at" is not null) or "org_members"."status" = 'revoked'

orgs_lifecycle_ck.name: orgs_lifecycle_ck
orgs_lifecycle_ck.value: ("orgs"."status" = 'pending' and "orgs"."activated_at" is null and "orgs"."suspended_at" is null and "orgs"."archived_at" is null) or ("orgs"."status" = 'active' and "orgs"."activated_at" is not null and "orgs"."suspended_at" is null and "orgs"."archived_at" is null) or ("orgs"."status" = 'suspended' and "orgs"."activated_at" is not null and "orgs"."suspended_at" is not null and "orgs"."archived_at" is null) or ("orgs"."status" = 'archived' and "orgs"."archived_at" is not null)

admin_delegation_grants_scope_ck.name: admin_delegation_grants_scope_ck

portal_access_grants_revocation_ck.name: portal_access_grants_revocation_ck

user_permission_overrides_scope_ck.name: user_permission_overrides_scope_ck
